item.title: Show HN: A visual ping utility that is pretty
item.summary: As a network engineer, I use ICMP every day. The default ping utility is ugly, I used a prettyping instead. But it got some bugs, isn't configurable and need bash. So I made my own. I hope it will help some other IT guy. For reference, prettyping: https://github.com/denilsonsa/prettyping Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49325004 Points: 1 # Comments: 0
